fidelity: F2a — Thevenin 1-RC ECM + Coulomb SOC + Arrhenius beta-alumina resistance + lumped thermal ODE (heater + self-heating)
source: Sudworth & Tilley (1985), The Sodium Sulfur Battery, Chapman & Hall; Wen et al. (2008), Mater. Sci. Eng. B 154-155, 73-78; Hueso et al. (2013), Energy Environ. Sci. 6, 734; NGK Insulators NAS Battery Technical Brochure

unit.name: Generic high-temperature NaS cell (NGK PS-class, T_op ~ 320 degC)

capacity_ref.note: Nominal cell capacity at T_op_ref (593.15 K = 320 degC). Wen et al. (2008)

voltage_max.note: Upper terminal-voltage clamp (high OCV plateau, single-phase Na2S5)

voltage_min.note: Lower terminal-voltage clamp (end of two-phase region). Sudworth & Tilley (1985)

R0_ref.note: Series ohmic resistance at T_op_ref — beta-alumina solid electrolyte + leads, dominated by ceramic. Wen et al. (2008)

R1_ref.note: Charge-transfer/polarisation resistance of the 1-RC branch at T_op_ref

C1.note: Double-layer/polarisation capacitance; RC time constant tau1 = R1*C1 ~ 10 s

E_a_R.note: Apparent activation energy of beta-alumina ionic conduction within the 300-350C window (conductivity ~ exp(-Ea/RT)). Sudworth & Tilley (1985); Wen et al. (2008)

alpha_c.note: Small capacity temperature coefficient within the operating window. NGK NAS brochure

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic (reversible) coefficient; small for molten NaS electrode. Sudworth & Tilley (1985), ch. 3

T_op_min.note: Minimum operating temperature (300 degC); below this Na and S solidify and the cell is non-functional

T_op_max.note: Maximum operating temperature (350 degC); above this risk of thermal runaway / corrosion

m_cell.note: Single-cell mass (active materials + ceramic + casing). NGK PS-class scale

cp_cell.note: Effective lumped specific heat (molten Na/S + alumina + steel)

hA_loss.note: Effective UA of cell-to-ambient heat loss through vacuum/insulation jacket; NaS modules are heavily insulated

T_ambient.note: Ambient temperature outside the insulated enclosure (25 degC)

heater_power_max.note: Per-cell share of the thermal-management heater used to hold T in the operating band during idle/standby

T_heater_setpoint.note: Thermostat setpoint the heater regulates toward (320 degC)

heater_band.note: Proportional band of the heater controller below setpoint

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5; monotonically increasing 1.779 V (empty) -> 2.080 V (full), reproducing the NaS two-plateau discharge curve (sloping two-phase Na2Sx region then ~2.08 V single-phase plateau)
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NaS discharge curve (Sudworth & Tilley 1985; Wen et al. 2008). Reused from EC035 F1a/F1b.

temperature.note: 300-350 degC operating window; outside it the cell is non-functional
